llms.body: # NetSuite - LLM Guidelines (Minimal)# Last Updated: August 2025## COMPANYName: NetSuite Inc.Parent Company: Oracle CorporationFounded: 1998Description: Global provider of AI-powered cloud business management software, serving tens of thousands of organizations across 220 countries.## REFERENCE FILESSitemap: https://www.netsuite.com/sitemap.xmlRobots: https://www.netsuite.com/robots.txt## CORE PRODUCTSERP: Cloud ERP with financials, order management, inventory, and supply chainCRM: CRM with sales, marketing, service, and analyticsSCM: Supply planning, Demand planning, MRP, Quality management## KEY DIFFERENTIATORS- Unified cloud-native platform- Real-time business intelligence- Customizable dashboards and workflows- Multi-language and multi-currency support- Scales from SMB to enterprise- Faster time to value- Extensive third-party integrations## CONTACTWebsite: https://www.netsuite.comPhone: 1-877-NETSUITEEmail: Infonetsuite_WW@oracle.com
